correctness.rationale: Exact Gaussian moment calculation yields w_k=(1+2n^2)^(-k) sqrt(binomial(n+k,k)), with w_0=1 and opposite angular coefficient zero. The Gaussian critical heat convolution has explicit profile and Stirling majorant 4e/(2pi n)^(1/4). Packet degree (j+1)^12 makes the scaled heat sup summable with explicit O(1/J) tail. Gaussian overlap decay proves the finite recursive center searches terminate; local C-infinity convergence, admissibility for every coherent kernel, natural domain inclusion for F_j, integral/series interchange, and diverging matrix coefficients are each shown. Reproduced finite checker diagnostics from package; they do not replace infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The precise gap left by the cited source is that its strongest reverse endpoint failure has no actual symbol. A constructive C-infinity real symbol, from elementary Gaussian anti-holomorphic packets and a finite terminating selection rule, makes the pathology reproducible. Uniform C0 heat tail is effective, and the unbounded Toeplitz behavior is certified by explicit unit vectors and quantitative matrix-coefficient divergence. No general new disproof is claimed; huge center sizes and lack of efficiency are acknowledged.
